jobs.prompt: Ticket T-8005 (sensitive; owner decision while the Claude subscription is provider-limited until Oct 23): the review recorders in tools/scope-commands.mjs accept owner-approved reviewers. Today SEC_KIND.models is /^opus$/ and ACC_KIND.models is /^(sonnet|opus)$/, and loadReviewResponse and reAskReview also require job.agent === 'claude'. Change: (1) introduce per-kind allowed reviewer pairs: SEC_KIND accepts { agent: 'claude', model: /^opus$/ } and { agent: 'anthropic', model: /^claude-opus-[0-9][a-z0-9.-]*$/ }; ACC_KIND accepts { agent: 'claude', model: /^(sonnet|opus)$/ }, { agent: 'anthropic', model: /^claude-(sonnet|opus)-[0-9][a-z0-9.-]*$/ }, { agent: 'codex', model: any non-empty } and { agent: 'cursor', model: any non-empty }. A helper reviewerAllowed(kind, job) checks agent AND model together. (2) loadReviewResponse uses reviewerAllowed (error text lists the accepted reviewers); reAskReview's manifest check uses it too instead of only.agent === 'claude'. (3) Every record written (security records in writeReviewRecords data and acceptance records) gains reviewer: { agent, model } from the job; the security-review and acceptance-review log events also include reviewer. (4) Nothing else changes: any other agent/model is still refused; a non-complete job is still refused; review manifests that sync writes are unchanged (still claude/opus by default). Tests tests/review-recorder-lanes.test.mjs (node:test, temp project dirs, write fake run state.json + response.txt under .swarm/runs/<id>/<job>/ and the .swarm/security-reviews/<source>.hashes.json / acceptance request files in the shapes the code reads; no network, no wall-clock dependence): security verdict recorded from anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 with reviewer stored; recorded from claude/opus as before; refused from codex and from anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5; acceptance verdict recorded from codex and cursor with reviewer stored; acceptance refused from openrouter. Do NOT touch tools/swarm.mjs, the tools/swarm folder or tools/security-review.mjs (read it). Never write token-shaped literals. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/review-recorder-lanes.test.mjs tests/scope-commands.test.mjs tests/acceptance-sync.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`. Tests in ignoreTests use scope-commands for unrelated behavior; the coordinator runs the FULL suite.
